name: Federal Reserve
summary: Fed, Day 199. The most consequential non-kinetic reversal of the cycle: the September CUT that was a 'foregone conclusion' on 13 Aug is now an ~83–85%-priced HIKE for 16 Sep, after Warsh's Jackson Hole 'work to do' and a hot August CPI driven almost entirely by energy (gasoline +27% y/y, fuel oil +52%; core only 2.4% y/y). The Fed is tightening into an oil supply shock; its reaction function is now the oil price, which is now two chokepoints and a pipeline. Consequences: gold flat despite the war (real yields), EM carry unwinding (India FPI exits), defense de-rated, and BoJ/BoK tightening in parallel. A hold on Wednesday would be the dovish surprise that flips the dollar/gold regime; a hike with hawkish guidance confirms the regime.
